'''Horizon Assets Management''' is the company that holds the assets of [[HN Group]]. It owns the group's domains, Discord servers and technical assets, and manages all of HN Group's email services.

It is a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of [[HN Group]], alongside [[Horizon Network]] and [[Horizon Media Group]].

== Role ==
Horizon Assets Management keeps the things the whole group relies on in one place, separate from the companies that trade:

* '''Domains''' — the group's web and email domains
* '''Discord servers''' — the group's Discord communities
* '''Technical assets''' — the systems and other technical assets used across the group
* '''Email services''' — it manages email for HN Group and its companies

Its own domain is '''holding.hngroup.org.uk'''.

== Staff and management ==
Horizon Assets Management has no staff of its own. It is managed directly by the staff of [[HN Group]].

== Structure ==
* [[HN Group]]
** [[Horizon Network]]
*** [[Horizon Development]]
** [[Horizon Media Group]]
*** [[Horizon Advertising]] (managed by Horizon Network)
** '''Horizon Assets Management'''

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-assets-management-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Assets Management roundel]]
Like the other Horizon companies' logos, Horizon Assets Management's logo is a thick indigo ring containing its initials, alongside the company name. It is a separate logo from HN Group's: it is not a substitute for the HN Group wordmark.
